text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Today is the NHK Mile Cup, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about the time! More 
importantly, sorry for calling you out so 
suddenly first thing in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There's something I just have to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Would you come watch me at the NHK Mile 
Cup today?

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I was watching the press conference. 
You really meant it, didn't you? About 
putting on the greatest show.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even for you, Senpai, I wonder... I think 
this is a pretty deeply rooted problem.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To be honest, I was debating whether 
to take on the Derby right up until the 
very last minute.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You see, when I was a child, I couldn't 
become like the person I admired in the 
show world, so I chose the path of racing 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When you speak of the Derby in the racing 
world, it truly is a once-in-a-lifetime 
grand stage, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I can stand on that stage and achieve 
victory, then maybe I can hold my head 
high before the one I admire so much—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, even if you can't win, you can still 
put on a show as the challenger.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So you felt that way too.

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Then, why...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At my best-suited distance, I'll deliver 
the greatest performance I possibly can 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was simply captivated by that potential.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You gave me that push I needed, Trainer. 
That's why I'm running the mile division 
now.

Fuji Kiseki offered a gentle smile to her 
bewildered junior.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The reason the crowd gets so thrilled 
watching races isn't simply because 
they're famous races.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's because the Umamusume running there 
shone so brightly and showed us such 
magnificent drama that everyone got so 
passionate!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If we shine, it'll become the greatest 
race of all. Milers or Classics, it 
doesn't matter. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There is absolutely no reason for an 
Umamusume who runs the mile to be 
considered inferior to one who runs the 
Classics...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've staked even more on today's race than 
the feelings I held for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So please, won't you come watch me?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I came to cheer for her, but... honestly, 
I was really hoping for the Triple Crown 
path, so it's a bit disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I really wanted to see Fuji Kiseki 
run in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Fugh...! People sure have a lot to say 
about Lord Fuji! I hope she's alright~

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, pull yourself together! If we don't 
believe in her, who will?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
Look at me, I remade this whole banner in 
super record time! All that's left is to 
cheer with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, as expected of the leader...!

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“...... When you put it like that, how 
could I not show up?”

Amidst a flurry of different emotions, the 
curtain rose on the NHK Mile Cup!
